title: Return a struct
description:
Reference parameters are one way to hand back two answers. Returning a small struct is usually cleaner.

Define `struct MinMax` with `int` members `min` and `max`, and write `MinMax findMinMax(int a, int b, int c)`.

The caller can then unpack it in one line: `auto [lo, hi]{ findMinMax(4, 9, 2) };`
